DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：✨ 提示词一键增强 + 💬 语音输入插件功能增强

Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.

description.zh: 在任意 dsh 上打开并操控你 tailnet 里的所有 dsh，手机端界面也完整好用。

DeepSeek Harness workflow kit: 5 agent presets + 18 skills + routing table

Poppin'Party Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness (local models, zero external deps)

Weixin iLink channel for DeepSeek Harness — text, media, persona modes, settings page (QR login, allowlist), companion pacing and proactive messages.
ARIS research-workflow skills as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 82 skills plus cross-model adversarial review through Codex.
AI 驱动的法律行业案件管理与 Agent 工具：诉讼案件 / 非诉项目 / 任务中心 / 期限引擎 / 技能与 MCP，Agent 预设直接办案，运行于 DeepSeek Harness。
星主制作的大肥鱼世界，希望大家喜欢！

DeepSeek Harness opening splash: plays the DSH software-opening animation full screen when the Web UI boots, then fades into the app (skippable, speed and frequency configurable)
DeepSeek Harness plugin: AnySearch-backed web search with optional TinyFish and DeepSeek search/fetch, registered into ctx.web.

HAZOP 分析表要素齐备性与偏差推导一致性核对（依据公开的危险与可操作性分析标准，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 分析表是否合规：逐行核对模板要求的内容，并验证偏差是否真由工艺参数推出。

description.en: Scriptor 检索增强：嵌入、场景识别与重排
被 dsh-memory-shield 遮蔽的会话的隔离记忆包：五轨（memory/user/project/key/daily）独立数据目录，与 dsh-memory-evolve 完全隔离。装完即已生效——默认只提供管理页，不接管任何会话；在目标 preset 里设 memoryEnabled: true 才启用。
Use locally authenticated coding subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness model providers.
Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
Agent-safe EVM wallet for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): encrypted local keys, signing policy and spending limits, pre-signing security checks, x402 payments
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体配一个安全的 EVM 钱包，本地加密私钥、限额签名、付款前先做安全检查，还能直接走 x402 支付。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
DSH Web 插件：把 DSH Web GUI 发布到 tailnet（远程入口），并把 tailnet 设备与可达性暴露为 ctx.tailscale 服务，供其他插件消费
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面发布到 Tailscale 内网，让 tailnet 里的设备随时访问，并查看设备在线情况。

description.en: A durable, fenced cold-start scheduler and isolated Agent runner for DeepSeek Harness.
A minimal installable DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle.
A bounded, append-only outcome evaluation ledger for the DSH personal assistant.
Approval-gated behavioural self-evolution for the DSH personal assistant.

Use your logged-in web AI (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao...) as model providers in DeepSeek Harness. Web models emit tool calls, DSH runs them under its native permission system, and results return to the same web session. No API keys.
dsh plugin: SYSTEM proxy (env) + LLM traffic-splitting proxy via a process-global undici routing dispatcher
description.zh: 把 LLM 请求按配置分流到指定代理，其余流量走系统代理，没配就直连。

description.en: Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。

Delete sessions of a DeepSeek Harness profile from the UI: session-row menu item with a confirm dialog; the host endpoint deletes the log, projection cache and workspace accounting, cascading through the whole subagent tree. Optionally exposes session_lis
A Super Relay OpenAI Responses route with conservative goal-budget token metering.
Capture independently accepted tool workflows and replay versioned skills through the current native Goal and tool authority.
Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.

Aliyun DashScope (Bailian) model provider for DeepSeek Harness: registers an `aliyun` route whose model list comes from the configured endpoint itself, with a shipped fallback catalog for capacities and offline use.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入阿里云百炼（DashScope）模型，自带通义千问系列，开箱即用。

description.en: Managed document pipeline for the DeepSeek Harness: DOCX/PDF, XLSX/CSV/TSV/OpenDocument spreadsheets, Markdown and online sources as agent tools
DSH 插件：团队 —— 可保存复用的团队模板，成员可各自使用不同 Agent 预设（能力不同），在会话输入框选中后由队长调度协作并统一汇总。
质保期与索赔金额核对（按质保期月数与里程、索赔金额算式核对自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查质保索赔台账的算术和日期是否自洽，帮你在理赔前发现记录错误。

description.en: 试卷解析结构核对（按题型、答案、分值与 yotta 标识核对试卷结构自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查试卷解析结果的结构是否自洽，确保每道题的题号、题干、答案和分值都齐全。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 设置导航与斜杠菜单顺序：重排、隐藏设置侧栏；为 agent-teams、companion、acp、acp-cache 补充图标和中文标题，支持自定义默认顺序。偏好随浏览器本地状态及 $DSH_HOME/dsh-settings-nav-order/state.json 持久化。
DSH plugin: model-generated session titles that follow the latest task, remember manual renames, persist their settings, and never fail silently.
Coopanion desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a whale-girl mascot that speaks, moves and can be driven by the agent
应急演练脚本核对（按阶段、响应分级、指挥与资源要素核对脚本齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查应急演练脚本是否完整、步骤和响应级别算得对不对，帮你提前发现漏洞。

description.en: 数据资产化共享基础包 — 共享类型定义、业务常量、工具函数（基础依赖）
DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 合同条款立场核对：依据《中华人民共和国民法典》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查合同条款立场台账，确保条款文本、立场和风险等级都记录规范、有据可查。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 作文评分表核对：依据《普通高中语文课程标准》《普通高等学校招生全国统一考试评卷工作规定》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查作文量表评分表的算术和证据，核对每项标准、等级描述与分数上限是否对得上。

description.en: A DSH plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool + more built-in LLM Providers
description.zh: 把一个厂商 API Key 变成可管理的密钥池，还内置更多 LLM 厂商，省心又省钱。

description.en: Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archive, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall, 1600-token memory snapshot. ｜ 陪伴 AI 冷热分层记忆：全自动归档 + 渐进冷存 + 线索召回。
description.zh: 给陪伴 AI 加上冷热分层记忆，自动归档对话、渐进冷存、按线索召回，省 token 不忘事。

description.en: 把 DSH 的会话库管起来：迁移工作区与会话到新目录，导出 / 导入 .dshsess 会话包，用 WebDAV 在多台机器之间同步。
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话库管起来：迁移工作区、导出导入会话包，还能用 WebDAV 多机同步。

description.en: AI Book Shelf / AI 书架：书籍与论文阅读、AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读电子书和论文，AI 帮你解释内容、全文搜索，还能翻译论文做中英对照。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Connects the CallAI SEO MCP server: 10 SEO data tools plus a generic DataForSEO request tool for Google/Bing SERP (with AI Overview sources), keyword volume and difficulty, long-tail ideas, competitor keyword gaps, backlinks and page audits. Includes a callai-seo skill. Requires a CallAI API key; pay as you go.
description.zh: 连接 CallAI SEO MCP 服务，提供 10 个 SEO 数据工具和 1 个 DataForSEO 通用请求工具：Google/Bing 搜索结果（含 AI Overview 引用来源）、关键词搜索量与难度、长尾词、竞品关键词差距、外链和页面审计。附带 callai-seo 技能。需要 CallAI API Key，按量付费。

description.en: Daily check-in for Nanjing Forestry University's ACM AI Hub plus seat booking for its library — both site addresses are hardcoded — with a settings page and a progress badge; built for DeepSeek Harness Mobile (DSHM) on Android.
description.zh: 南京林业大学 ACM AI Hub 每日签到与该校图书馆座位预约（两个站点地址写死），带设置页与完成度角标；面向 Android 上的 DeepSeek Harness Mobile。

description.en: Floating DeepSeek API time-of-day pricing window with Chinese legal-holiday awareness, account balance and estimated project spend; includes a green/orange 24-hour timeline and collapsible model, billing-rule and holiday sections.
description.zh: DeepSeek API 时段价格悬浮窗，联网读取中国法定节假日，显示账户余额与本项目花费估算；含绿/橙 24 小时时间轴和可折叠的模型、计费规则、节假日区块。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API-key balance as one ambient stat in the Harness composer row, refreshed every 60 seconds. Click the balance to set a local low-balance threshold; the amount turns red below it. The API key stays in the host and is only sent to api.deepseek.com/user/balance.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的统计行里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，每 60 秒自动刷新；点击余额可设置本地低余额阈值，低于阈值时金额变红。API Key 只留在本机 Host，仅用于请求 api.deepseek.com/user/balance。

plugins.name: DSH Notebook · 私人笔记管理

description.en: Save conversations, manage notes with images, export files, and sync across devices through your own private GitHub repository.
description.zh: 保存会话、管理图文笔记、导出文件，通过自己的 GitHub 私有仓库跨设备同步。

description.en: Store account credentials in an encrypted browser-local vault.
description.zh: 在浏览器本地加密保存账号凭据。

description.en: GitHub-style activity heatmap in the sidebar, one cell per day over 30/90/365-day ranges, with token usage and estimated cost per model and editable per-model prices.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的活动热力图，一格一天，支持近 30、90、365 天，统计 token 用量与按模型估算的费用，单价可自行修改。

description.en: Adds an Agent docs tab to the conversation view: it lists the AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction files DSH actually loads for the current session (the ~/.dsh and ~/.agents roots, plus every directory from the project root to the working directory), previews each as Markdown with per-file sizes and the 64 KiB instruction budget, edits and saves them in place after a sha256 version check, and opens the workspace folder from the path button; a saved file takes effect on the next message.
description.zh: 在对话页签栏新增「智能体文档」页签：列出当前会话实际加载的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.local.md / CLAUDE.local.md 指令文件（~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents 两个全局根，以及项目根到工作区的每一级目录），以 Markdown 预览并显示各文件大小与 64 KiB 指令预算，点「编辑」可就地改写、保存前做 sha256 内容冲突校验，点击工作区路径会在文件管理器中打开；保存后从下一条消息生效。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AIyting's image generation MCP endpoint and registers four tools: aiyting_image_catalog (models, routes and specs), aiyting_image_settings (read, quote and save parameters), aiyting_image_generate (return a quote first, and submit only with an explicit credit ceiling) and aiyting_image_task (task lookup, waiting, and a local per-account ledger for unfinished jobs). A sidebar page signs in with an AIyting access key, shows points, today's usage and daily quota, logs out, and keeps per-conversation defaults for model, route, aspect ratio, resolution and count.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AIyting 的生图 MCP 端点，注册四个工具：aiyting_image_catalog（模型、线路与规格）、aiyting_image_settings（读取、报价与保存参数）、aiyting_image_generate（先返回报价，只有显式给出点数上限才提交）、aiyting_image_task（任务查询、等待，以及按账号保存在本机的未完成任务台账）。侧栏页面用 AIyting 接入密钥登录，显示点数、今日用量与每日上限，可退出登录，并按对话保存模型、线路、比例、分辨率与张数的默认值。

description.en: Keeps a turn from closing on an unfinished reply: a stream guard turns silent truncation into an in-step retry, and a completion protocol asks the model to declare how each turn ended.
description.zh: 避免轮次停在「话没说完」或「只写了下一步计划」上关闭：把静默截断的流转成同一步内可重试的失败，并要求模型在每轮结束时声明收尾方式。

description.en: Six switchable background palettes, a custom image, or any solid color for DeepSeek Harness, with adjustable opacity and a dedicated Background settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六套可切换背景、自定义图片或任意纯色，可调节不透明度，并注册为独立的「背景」设置页。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service for file search, file metadata, and storage quota. Requires Baidu account authorization after installation.
description.zh: 百度网盘 MCP 插件，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索网盘文件、查看文件信息和查询容量。安装后需授权百度账号。

description.en: Connects the Bowmark hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes, so the agent can search a library of typed functions for live websites and call them. The API key is read from the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Bowmark 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具，让智能体搜索并调用面向实时网站的类型化函数库。API Key 从 BOWMARK_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Soft-branches a self-contained sub-question into a child session and returns only a bounded digest, so the main context grows by a short summary instead of the whole investigation.
description.zh: 把自包含的子问题软分支到子会话，只把一页以内的结构化摘要带回主上下文。

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: BreezeBlue text-to-speech for DSH: three agent tools, a header toggle that reads assistant replies aloud (markdown and code blocks stripped), and local HTTP endpoints for audio playback, synthesis and long-poll delivery. Requires a BreezeBlue API key (BREEZE_API_KEY); synthesis is billed per character.
description.zh: 把 BreezeBlue 语音接入 DSH：三个工具、会话头开关自动朗读助手回复（自动剥离 Markdown 与代码块），并提供音频播放、合成与长轮询的本地 HTTP 接口。需配置 BreezeBlue API Key（BREEZE_API_KEY），合成按字符计费。

description.en: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a mid-turn question has context, denies every tool call at execution time, and keeps a per-session topic history with follow-up, stop, retry and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 /btw 旁问：fork 当前会话，并在主回合仍在运行时补入当前任务、最近的工具调用和流式输出作为上下文；执行期拒绝所有工具调用；按会话保留支持追问、停止、重试和删除的主题历史。

description.en: Draws every question and answer in the DSH Web conversation blurred until the pointer rests on that row, and locks the mask to always-blurred while the window is unfocused; one control below the composer switches between off, hover to reveal, and always blurred, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 对话里的提问与回答画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条才显示哪一条；窗口失焦时自动全糊，谁都看不到指针留下的那条。输入框下方一个按钮在「关闭 / 悬停显示 / 始终模糊」三档间切换，选择按浏览器记住。

description.en: Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through Claude subscription accounts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以 OAuth 登录的 Claude 订阅账号运行 Claude 模型，每个账号一条独立 provider 路由与一份可编辑的模型列表，提供 /claude-login、/claude-account、/claude-usage、/claude-logout 命令，并在输入框显示配额用量。

description.en: Video workbench for DeepSeek Harness that parses a link, downloads the source, transcribes it, trims or merges clips and exports GIFs. Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and yt-dlp; whisper.cpp plus a model is optional for videos without subtitles.
description.zh: 视频工作台：贴链接解析并下载、转写文案、截取拼接片段、按目标体积导出 GIF。需自备 ffmpeg/ffprobe 与 yt-dlp；无字幕视频的本地转写另需 whisper.cpp 与模型（可选）。

description.en: Read-only semantic code navigation for DeepSeek Harness via local language servers: definitions, references, symbols, diagnostics, hover, and rename preview.
description.zh: 通过本地语言服务器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读语义代码导航：定义、引用、符号、诊断、悬停和重命名预览。

description.en: Switch OpenAI models between Codex-style Responses WebSocket transport and SSE from the composer, inheriting DSH provider settings with an optional priority-tier toggle.
description.zh: 继承 DSH 渠道配置，在输入框旁切换 OpenAI 模型的 Codex 风格 Responses WebSocket 与 SSE 传输，并可开启优先处理模式。

description.en: Monitors Windows console windows and hides or closes empty ones — consoles whose interpreter process has no business child process left besides conhost or openconsole and stays idle at about zero CPU. Recognizes both classic console windows and Windows Terminal CASCADIA tabs that only host a bare cmd, powershell, pwsh or python prompt. Hard-protects Fluent, MPI and solver processes, the DSH host, Explorer and the foreground window, so running solvers are never touched. Also provides a taskbar window cleanup action named close other windows, plus a persistent exemption whitelist of process names and title keywords stored in ~/.dsh/console-sentinel/whitelist.json. A settings panel under Settings then Console Sentinel shows live window status, one click hide of empty consoles, a taskbar cleanup preview and run button, and whitelist editing. Windows only.
description.zh: 监控 Windows 控制台窗口，自动隐藏或关闭「空壳」控制台——解释器进程除 conhost / openconsole 外没有任何业务子进程、且长期 CPU 接近 0 的窗口。同时识别传统控制台与 Windows Terminal（CASCADIA）中只挂着裸 cmd / powershell / pwsh / python 提示符的标签页。对 Fluent、MPI、求解器进程、DSH 宿主、资源管理器与前台窗口做硬保护，绝不误伤正在计算的控制台。另提供「一键关闭其他窗口」的任务栏清理动作，以及持久化豁免白名单（进程名 + 标题关键字，落盘 ~/.dsh/console-sentinel/whitelist.json）。设置页「控制台哨兵」可查看实时窗口状态、一键隐藏空壳、预演并执行任务栏清理、编辑白名单。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Indexes each chat of a workspace into a small topic graph every 4 turns (one model call, verbatim source kept under .context-graph/), appends up to 5 matching topics from the other chats to each message, searching a named day such as "yesterday" first, and adds a recall tool that returns the original text by topic, chat, day or turn. On and shared by default; /context-graph off and unshare opt a chat out, and stats, build, map and find inspect it.
description.zh: 每 4 轮把工作区里的每个对话索引成小型主题图谱（一次模型调用，原文保存在 .context-graph/），在每条消息末尾附上其他对话中最多 5 个匹配主题，提到“昨天”等时间时先搜那一天，并提供 recall 工具按主题、对话、日期或轮次取回原文。默认开启并共享；/context-graph off 与 unshare 可让某个对话退出，stats、build、map、find 用于查看。

description.en: Windows-only guard against the desktop shell locking itself out: it counts the dsh-auth-* launch cookies the shell has accumulated, reports how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they consume, and once the count passes 40 it backs up the whole Cookies database and lets DSH rebuild it, so every cookie in that profile is cleared. Install is one command: on load the plugin registers its own weekly scheduled task pointing at the scripts inside the package, and uninstalling it removes that task — nothing to copy into your home directory and no schtasks line to run by hand. The check itself runs while the app is closed (it waits up to 3 hours for the shell to exit). It does not raise the header budget or keep a floating panel; scripts/ can also be run standalone without the app installed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，防止桌面外壳把自己锁死：数出已累积的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，报出它们占掉 16 KiB 请求头预算的比例；超过 40 条时把整个 Cookies 数据库备份后移走、由 DSH 重建，因此该 profile 下的所有 cookie 都会被清掉。安装只需一条命令：插件加载时自己注册指向包内脚本的每周计划任务，卸载时又把该任务一并删除——不用往用户目录复制文件，也不用手工敲 schtasks。检查本身在应用关闭时执行（会最多等 3 小时让外壳退出）。不抬高请求头预算、不挂常驻浮窗；scripts/ 里的脚本不装应用也能单独跑。

description.en: Track countdowns and recurring dates with optional reminders.
description.zh: 记录倒数日和重复日期，并可设置提醒。

description.en: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI with a one-month calendar of colored timeline bars and day tasks, a daily checklist, a seven-day week view with completion checkboxes and drag-to-reschedule, a draggable 24-hour day timeline, ordered per-day subtasks, weekly and every-N-days recurring tasks with per-occurrence result records, a long-term progress view opened from the calendar header, per-day completion for long-term tasks, a collapsible daily email reminder for any mailbox, and AI extraction of tasks from natural language.
description.zh: DailyBoard 是 DSH Web GUI 的日常工作任务板：单月日历（彩色时间条 + 当天任务）、日常清单、七天周视图（勾选完成、可拖动改期）与可拖拽的 24 小时时间轴，支持按天记录的有序子任务、按周几或每隔几天的周期任务及每次出现的结果记录、从日历标题栏打开的长期任务进展视图、长期任务按天完成标记、任意邮箱的每日邮件提醒，以及 AI 自然语言提取任务。

description.en: Restores the Windows desktop after a restart or power loss: snapshots open apps, documents, folders and window positions, and reopens them on demand. Windows 10+ only; automatic capture before shutdown needs two scheduled tasks registered once with collector/install-tasks.ps1.
description.zh: 重启或断电后恢复 Windows 桌面：快照已打开的程序、文档、文件夹与窗口位置，可一键重开。仅支持 Windows 10 及以上；关机前自动抓取需先用 collector/install-tasks.ps1 注册两个计划任务。

description.en: Windows-only desktop floating ball with a bilingual WebView2 quick-chat window, including in-window question and approval cards.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮球，内置中英文 WebView2 快捷聊天窗口，支持在窗口内回答提问和审批操作。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏底部加两个圆形按钮：重启应用（全程不闪黑窗）和打开 DeepSeek 充值页。重启走 WMI + wscript 拉起 helper，新进程不继承控制台；动手前会先核对可执行文件路径，并保留原始命令行。仅支持 Windows 10/11（包声明 os: win32）。

description.en: An Auto toggle next to the model selector that schedules reasoning_effort per request: complexity is scored by a MiniMax/OpenAI-compatible model with a zero-dependency heuristic fallback (fallbacks not cached), effort ladders adapt to each model real effort list (low/high/max, low/high/highx/max/ultra, ...), heavy tool calls upgrade the tier within the same session, the lit button and reply badges show the effort actually used, and every decision plus observed token usage lands in a JSONL ledger. A standalone-button fork of imkingjh999/dsh-adaptive-effort; do not install it and the original in the same profile.
description.zh: 输入栏模型选择器旁的「自动」按钮：按消息复杂度逐请求调度推理档位。档位表跟随各模型的真实分档（low/high/max 或 low/high/highx/max/ultra 等），MiniMax/OpenAI 兼容端点打分、失败回退零依赖启发式（回退结果不缓存）；同会话内出现重工具调用自动升档；点亮按钮与回复角标实时显示实际使用的档位；每次调度决策与实际 token 用量记入 JSONL 账本。本插件是 imkingjh999/dsh-adaptive-effort 的独立按钮 fork，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Exa web search and fetch provider for DSH: replaces built-in web search and exposes multi-source research capabilities.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的 DSH 网页搜索与抓取插件：完全接管内置网络检索，并提供多源深度调研工具。

description.en: Annotates bash results whose exit code 1 is an answer rather than an error (grep with no match, diff with differences, false test) so the agent does not re-investigate them.
description.zh: 为 exit code 1 表示结果而非错误的 bash 输出（grep 无匹配、diff 有差异、test 为假）补充说明，避免 agent 反复排查。

description.en: Review every five distinct ended project sessions in DeepSeek Harness, retain sourced lessons and workflow drafts, and supply project memory to later sessions.
description.zh: 每五个不同的项目会话结束后自动复盘，积累有来源的经验与工作流草稿，并为后续会话带入项目记忆。

description.en: Typography settings page: text, code and terminal font size and family, plus interface, conversation and code text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and line height, with a live preview.
description.zh: 字体设置页：正文、代码与终端的字号和字体族，外加界面、会话与代码的文字颜色、字重、斜体、字间距与行高，带实时预览。

description.en: Pushes a notification when a long agent turn finishes, a turn fails, or an approval waits too long, via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, ServerChan, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram or a webhook. Port of @magpie-community/gateway-notify (MIT); the upstream is a magpie API-gateway plugin that does not install into DSH, so the two never coexist in one host.
description.zh: 长任务结束、回合失败或审批等待过久时推送通知，支持 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 与 webhook。移植自 @magpie-community/gateway-notify（MIT）；上游是 magpie API 网关插件，无法装进 DSH，两者不会同装。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64), and run GIS summary/buffer/overlay on SHP/GeoJSON/KML — pure-JS parsing, no GDAL.
description.zh: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git tab for DeepSeek Harness that lists working-tree changes with inline diffs and the commit graph, commits (locally or with a push), fast-forward pulls, and switches branches while the working tree is clean.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 页签：列出工作区改动并内联显示差异、浏览提交树，支持一键提交（仅本地或提交并推送）、快进拉取，并在工作区干净时切换分支。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: Durable session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: pressure-aware handoff docs, a searchable transcript, and automatic continuation in a fresh Session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话交接：上下文压力到阈值时写交接文档与可搜索转录，并在新会话里自动继续。

description.en: Localizes the prompts DeepSeek Harness sends to the model — system prompt sections, runtime context, tool descriptions and parameter docs — into Simplified Chinese. Its Cordis API dictionary is derived from zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn (MIT), which translates the same prompt layers at runtime; do not enable both at once.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 发给模型的提示词——系统提示词各段、运行时上下文、工具描述与参数说明——翻译成简体中文。Cordis API 词典派生自 zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn（MIT），后者同样在运行时翻译同一批提示词层；不要同时启用两者。

description.en: Event-based memory for long-lived chat bots: emotion-weighted decay, three confidence levels on recall, superseding outdated facts, per-subject isolation, plus relationship, fact, chapter, skill and gap tables. Ships a CLI, an HTTP endpoint and a DSH plugin bundle.
description.zh: 给长期陪伴型机器人的记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、召回分三档确定度、改口即失效、按人隔离，另有关系、事实、章节、技能、缺口五张表。包含命令行、HTTP 接口和 DSH 插件三件套。

description.en: Codex-inspired lifecycle command hooks for DSH, with explicit tool-input sharing, pre-tool deny policies, notifications, and local audit examples.
description.zh: DSH 的 Codex 风格生命周期命令钩子，支持工具参数显式共享、执行前拒绝，以及通知与本地审计示例。

description.en: Encrypted file handoffs and cross-device agent collaboration with background message reception and managed task execution in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中进行加密文件交接与跨设备 Agent 协作，支持后台收件和受管任务执行。

description.en: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzPost tools as mcp__juzpost__* plus a workflow skill that confirms with the user before anything is published. Needs a JuzPost API key in JUZPOST_API_KEY; JuzPost issues API keys on paid plans.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将智能体连接到 JuzPost（社交媒体排程工具）：列出已连接账号、检查各平台限制、上传媒体，并向 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、X、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Tumblr 和 WordPress 起草、排程或发布帖子。注册 mcp__juzpost__* 工具及一个发布前先向用户确认的工作流技能。需要在 JUZPOST_API_KEY 中提供 JuzPost API 密钥；JuzPost 的 API 密钥需付费方案才能创建。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: LibTV canvas and media tools for DeepSeek Harness, with three director skills bundled and one-time WeChat QR authorization.
description.zh: 把 LibTV 的画布与媒体生成能力接进 DeepSeek Harness，随包附带三个导演技能，首次使用微信扫码授权一次即可。

description.en: Local-first, file-backed memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown memories, verified trust, per-turn recall, and optional SQLite FTS5.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本地优先、基于文件的记忆插件：支持 Markdown 记忆存储、可验证的信任机制、逐轮次回忆，以及可选的 SQLite FTS5 全文检索。

description.en: Renders the seven-layer SQLite store of meow-memory as a live 3D star map, with draggable nodes, layer rings and a click-through detail panel. Requires the meow-memory plugin and Node 22.5+.
description.zh: 把 meow-memory 的七层记忆库实时画成 3D 星图，光点可拖拽、可按层筛选，点开可看全文与元数据；需先安装 meow-memory 插件，并要求 Node 22.5+。

description.en: Meteor-night wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: a sharp full-window meteor picture, transparent sidebar and night-only ink.
description.zh: 流星夜色：整窗流星夜空壁纸、透明侧栏、夜间配色，桌面端与 dsh web 通用。

description.en: DeepSeek official-site-inspired skin for DSH: dark aurora, particle whale and constellation backdrop, plus a light blue glass theme that follows the host color scheme. DSH Web only: verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; the Desktop app is not yet verified.
description.zh: 灵感来源于 DeepSeek 官网的 DSH 皮肤：深色模式提供流体极光、粒子鲸鱼与星座背景，浅色模式采用蓝色玻璃质感，并跟随宿主深浅色设置切换。仅支持 DSH Web（DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 实测通过）；桌面版尚未验证。

description.en: Onshelf for DeepSeek Harness. It registers 1 agent tool (onshelf).
description.zh: 扫描本地插件、体检收录规则、生成投稿材料，一键开 PR 到 awesome-dsh-plugin。

description.en: Hides unused panels in the left rail grouped by origin, and turns the rail More button into an expand/collapse toggle that lays out every panel.
description.zh: 把左侧栏用不到的面板按来源分组收起；「更多」按钮变成一键展开/折叠全部面板的开关。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control and a Markdown notes vault.
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

description.en: Adds a { } button under each assistant reply in the DSH Web GUI that opens the exact request sent to the model for that reply: model, call parameters, messages, tools, and provider-reported token usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 每条 assistant 回复下方加一个 { } 按钮，点开可查看产生这条回复的那次调用实际发给模型的完整请求：model、调用参数、messages、tools 与 provider 上报的 token 用量。

description.en: Permanently deletes a conversation, optionally together with the documents and attachments it created.
description.zh: 彻底删除对话，可选择同时删除该对话创建的文档与附件。

description.en: Scheduled daily toast popups summarizing yesterday's conversations and managing two-tier pending TODOs.
description.zh: 每日定时弹窗推送昨日对话要点提炼与双轨待办事项管理。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the left of the composer status row; clicking it opens a panel with the normal and bonus wallet split, the refresh time and a top-up link. The chip and panel read the host surface tokens, so they follow the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine glass settings, theme and wallpaper changes.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的用量行最左侧显示账户余额，点开可查看普通余额与赠送额度的分项、更新时间，并可跳转充值；徽标与浮层读取宿主表面 token，可跟随 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 的玻璃参数、明暗主题与壁纸切换。

description.en: Plugin steward for DeepSeek-Harness: checks every installed plugin for newer versions and installs them, snapshots the profile first and rolls back automatically when the post-update health check regresses. Also scans plugin code for risky behaviour before you install (eval, reverse shell, credential access), browses the 8.5k-plugin catalog with compatibility badges, restarts the host by itself after install/uninstall/disable, and shows everything in plain language.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 插件管家：查出所有插件的新版本并直接升级，升级前自动建快照，升级后重新体检，结果变差就自动还原。装任何插件前先静态扫描代码（动态执行、反弹 shell、翻密钥都会标出来），内置 8489 个插件的市场目录并带兼容性判定，装完/卸完/停用完自动重启宿主，不需要手动关软件。界面文案全白话，不写术语。

description.en: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows a diff first: version conflicts default to the newer side, entries only the Gist has stay by default, and entries only the local machine has are pushed. Each update can pick the npm or the GitHub channel, and every install goes through the plugin manager with a live log.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: Bundled LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷) typeface plugin: switches the Web GUI interface and conversation text to the kai-style font with no configuration, using a system-installed copy when present and otherwise serving the packaged offline web font.
description.zh: 内置霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）字体的插件：零配置把网页界面与对话文字切换为楷体风格，优先使用系统已安装字体，未安装时按需加载包内离线字体。

description.en: Light and dark theme editor with 14 exposed color controls, typography settings, named presets, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 明暗主题编辑器，提供 14 项公开颜色编辑、字体字号设置、命名主题保存与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: Composer button that rewrites the current draft with four style presets, selection-only rewriting, a keyboard shortcut and instant undo; no settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键改写草稿：四种风格档位、划词改写、快捷键与即时撤销，无设置页。

description.en: Fixes web_fetch failing with "non-public IP address" while Clash, Surge or v2rayN runs in TUN/fake-IP mode: finds your local HTTP proxy by itself, sends web_fetch through it while the proxy is on and directly when it is off, and adds an Auto/Proxy/Direct switch to the sidebar. Model calls are left alone by default.
description.zh: 修复开着 Clash / Surge / v2rayN（TUN、fake-IP）时 web_fetch 报 non-public IP address 的问题：自动找到本机 HTTP 代理，代理开着走代理、关了直连；侧栏可一键切换「自动 / 走代理 / 直连」。默认只接管 web_fetch，不影响模型调用。

description.en: Quota monitor for GLM, MiniMax, Kimi and DeepSeek coding plans — per-window usage, reset countdowns and manual refresh in the Web GUI.
description.zh: GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek 编程套餐额度监控——Web GUI 内显示各窗口用量、重置倒计时并支持手动刷新。

description.en: Animated desktop pets, one mascot per coding-plan provider (GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo). Poses follow the running session; moods follow quota usage read from dsh-quota-hub.
description.zh: 动画桌宠，每家编程套餐一只吉祥物（GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek、MiMo）。动作跟随会话运行状态，心情跟随 dsh-quota-hub 的额度用量。

description.en: Adds a relay_check tool that runs relaycheck against an LLM API relay to detect model swaps, misreported usage, truncated context and injected prompts; keys are read from environment variables.
description.zh: 提供 relay_check 工具，用 relaycheck 检测 LLM API 中转是否调包模型、虚报用量、截断上下文或注入提示词；key 只从环境变量读取。

description.en: Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: expose this machine's DSH Web GUI through an SSH reverse tunnel and a QR gate — scan and enter. Requires your own Linux server with root SSH access plus nginx, openssl and qrencode; it rewrites that server's nginx config, and the QR link is a one-year login secret, so treat it like a password.
description.zh: 远程接入插件：把本机 DSH 经 SSH 反向隧道映射到服务器并生成二维码，手机扫码直进本机 dsh。需自备可 root 登录的 Linux 服务器，并装好 nginx、openssl、qrencode；插件会改写该机 nginx 配置，二维码链接本身是一年有效的登录凭据，请当作密码保管。

description.en: Sidebar plugin updates with publish dates: each update pins an exact version and re-reads the installed manifest to confirm it landed, and updates whose new code needs a full relaunch are counted on a restart button — whose replacement process is started through WMI so it inherits no console. The full relaunch is Windows desktop only; the in-page GUI reload works on any platform.
description.zh: 在侧栏更新插件并显示发布时间：锁定精确版本，装完回读磁盘清单确认已到位；需要完全重启才生效的更新会计到重启按钮上，而完全重启经 WMI 拉起替代进程，新进程不继承任何控制台。完全重启仅在 Windows 桌面端可用，页面内 GUI 重载各平台都能用。

description.en: Right-sidebar file-preview enhancement built on `dsh-better-sidebar` (required — without it the plugin stays inert): a floating find bar for any text file (Ctrl+F, literal or regex, case-sensitive, match counter, next/previous) plus a collapsible Structure panel that lists classes, methods and file-level variables for Java, JavaScript, TypeScript and Python and an element outline for HTML (including .vue/.svelte), with click-to-line jumps. Read-only, no separate tab.
description.zh: 基于 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的右栏文件预览增强（必须先装它，否则插件静默不生效）：为任意文本文件提供漂浮查找条（Ctrl+F，字面量或正则、区分大小写、命中计数、上一个/下一个），并在代码右侧提供可折叠的「结构」面板——Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python 列出类/方法/文件级变量，HTML（含 .vue/.svelte）给元素大纲，点条目跳到对应行。只读，不注册独立页签。

description.en: Cross-project session grouping for the DSH sidebar: define named sections, assign sessions from any project into them, then collapse, rename, archive or move a whole project in one action; a toggle in the Sections panel swaps the host session browser for the section tree and restores it on demand, and each row flags live work or a completion you have not looked at yet.
description.zh: 把不同项目的会话收进左侧边栏里可折叠的自定义分组：会话行与项目行各有菜单，可加入分组、移出分组、重命名、归档，或把整个项目一次性移入某个分组；分组面板里的开关可把宿主侧栏切换成分组树、随时恢复，行尾还会提示会话正在跑或跑完还没看过。

description.en: Copy a user message together with its images and files, then paste it into any session: the text lands in the composer and each attachment is rebuilt through the official createDrafts/addAttachments path, so it uploads and sends like a normal draft.
description.zh: 复制用户消息时连同图片与文件一起捕获，粘贴到任意会话：文字进入输入框，每个附件经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道重建为真实草稿，可正常上传并发送。

description.en: Four-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the memory design of NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge (MIT) with the QQ channel removed: an append-only dialogue log, a weighted long-term fact store with decay and one-way archiving, self-notes the agent writes about itself, Chinese bigram recall over the raw log, and incremental AES-256-GCM sync to a private git repo where only ciphertext is stored. Archived sessions drop out of recall without losing their history.
description.zh: DSH 四层记忆插件（记忆设计移植自 NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge，MIT，去掉了 QQ 通道）：只增不改的原文库、带权重衰减与单向归档的长期事实库、智能体自己写的自我认知、原文库上的中文 bigram 检索，以及增量 AES-256-GCM 加密同步到只存密文的私有 git 仓库。会话归档后不再参与检索，但历史仍在库里。

description.en: Adds a cross-workspace activity sidebar for running, waiting and unread sessions, with search, optional pinned and scheduled-delivery groups, local read tracking and confirmed archiving.
description.zh: 跨工作区聚合运行中、待回复和未读会话，支持搜索、可选的置顶与定时交付分组、插件本地已读记录，以及经确认的归档操作。

description.en: Cross-session messaging across one or all workspaces: session_list finds top-level sessions by recency or title, session_send_message steers or queues attributed messages (cold-resuming stored sessions when needed), session_create opens titled top-level sessions with an initial task, and a client renderer displays relayed messages as user-side chat bubbles naming the sender session.
description.zh: 跨会话与跨工作区通信：session_list 按最近活跃或标题查找顶层会话，session_send_message 投递带来源标注的消息（支持 steer/queue，按需冷恢复已存储会话），session_create 新开带标题的顶层会话交代任务，前端渲染器把转发消息显示为标注发送方会话标题的用户侧气泡。

description.en: Delete a conversation record from the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a trash bin to restore or purge it.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里真正删除会话记录：带可恢复、可彻底清除的回收站。

description.en: Lists every session stored in the local DSH profile with its title, workspace, last-modified time and size, then moves the selected ones to a 90-day trash you can restore or purge; deletion detaches the live session first, so the sidebar updates without restarting the app.
description.zh: 列出本地 DSH 配置中保存的全部会话（标题、工作区、最近修改时间、大小），把选中项移入保留 90 天的回收站，可随时还原或彻底删除；删除前会先摘掉宿主内存中的会话，侧栏无需重启应用即可刷新。

description.en: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

description.en: Sidebar panel that lists every plugin installed in the current profile and gives each one an enable/disable switch.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：列出当前 profile 已安装的插件，每行带一个启用/停用开关。

description.en: Folder-style session panel: organize sidebar sessions into your own folders with drag-to-assign, per-session aliases and archived dimming. Display-only — it never touches DSH grouping.
description.zh: 文件夹式会话面板：把侧栏会话装进自建文件夹，支持拖拽归类、会话别名与归档变淡；只做显示，不改 DSH 自己的分组。

description.en: Route table assigning provider, model, and reasoning effort to subagents by workspace directory prefix; supports global default policy and in-composer session popover.
description.zh: 按工作区目录给子智能体指定 provider、模型与思考等级的路由表：最长前缀匹配后注入子代理配置，支持全局默认策略、设置页规则编辑与会话输入区就地切换。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory backed by Supermemory: pre-step semantic and chunk recall with per-session deduplication, debounced transcript upload, background LLM fact extraction (add/update/delete) with bigram and semantic deduplication, memory_search / memory_save / memory_forget tools, global or per-workspace container scoping, and a Plugins page UI for API key storage, memory CRUD, recall preview and activity log. Requires a Supermemory API key (a free monthly quota is available), and conversation excerpts are uploaded to Supermemory's cloud.
description.zh: 基于 Supermemory 的跨会话长期记忆：在 pre-step 按需执行语义与历史对话片段召回（同会话去重、首轮附带静态画像），回合结束后防抖上传脱敏对话并由后台模型提炼增删改事实（字面二元组与向量语义双层查重），提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具，支持全局或按工作区分库，并内置插件设置页管理 API Key、增删改查记忆、预览召回结果与查看活动日志。需自备 Supermemory API Key（有每月免费额度），对话片段会上传到 Supermemory 云端。

description.en: Local task checkpoints and bounded recovery for DSH, with optional L0–L3 hierarchical memory, dependency-aware retrieval, prerequisite-aware context, and six opt-in memory tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地任务检查点与有界恢复，并可选启用 L0–L3 层级记忆、依赖感知检索、先修知识上下文和六个按需启用的记忆工具。

description.en: Collects the open questions of each AI turn into a right-side panel; you answer them, add notes, and send the decisions back to the conversation in one message.
description.zh: 把 AI 每轮回复里的待决问题收进右侧边栏，选完选项、写完备注后一次性提交回对话。

description.en: Registers two LLM account pools as model providers: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI; paste a token once) with a daily 09:00 UTC+8 full-pool check-in — currently check-in, balances and model listing only, since its chat is blocked by the client signing key — and AutoClaw (Zhipu desktop, Windows), whose tokens are decrypted from the local DPAPI-protected credential store and whose chat streams through the desktop bridge. Both pools report credit balances and model catalogs; quota-triggered failover across local desktop instances is automatic, while switching the AutoClaw account is an opt-in setting (off by default). Panels ship in settings and the left sidebar.
description.zh: 把两个 LLM 账号池注册为模型提供方：TeleAgent（中国电信天翼 AI 星辰超级智能体，需手工粘贴一次 token）支持每天 09:00（UTC+8）全量自动签到，目前提供签到、余额与模型目录，对话仍被客户端签名密钥挡住；AutoClaw（智谱桌面端，Windows）的 token 由本机 DPAPI 保护的凭据解出，对话经桌面端桥接流式返回。两个号池都能查询积分余额与模型目录；额度耗尽时会自动在本地桌面端实例之间转移，切换 AutoClaw 账号则需在设置中开启（默认关闭）。设置页与左侧边栏均有面板。

description.en: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness: the Jing · Blazing Sunlight key art is inlined and painted into the window backdrop and both main panels, over an ink night sky with a molten gold sun, frosted mirror shards, drifting embers and a three-level motion switch (full / calm / off). Colours come from overridden design tokens, so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」主题：主视觉内联进插件，同时作为整窗底图与两个主面板的肌理；底子仍是墨色夜空、熔金日轮与光冕、磨砂镜片与飘浮金烬，左下角「镜」徽记可在 神光 / 静谧 / 关闭 三档动效间切换。配色通过覆写设计令牌实现，面板、气泡、菜单与代码块一并跟随。

description.en: Peak/valley pricing and spend dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar pill showing today's spend and tokens plus a details page with hourly, 14-day and per-model breakdowns.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量峰谷仪表盘：侧栏胶囊常显峰谷、今日花费与 tokens，详情页提供 24 小时、近 14 天与按模型的用量拆分。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在侧边栏对话列表上方增加关注区：每行一个状态圆点（未读、待回复、运行中、失败），有新回复的置顶、运行中的置底，模型选择器左侧还有关注按钮。

description.en: Animated ASCII orca-ocean wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness that follows local time, with native plugin settings for brightness, saturation and composition.
description.zh: 随系统时间变化的 ASCII 虎鲸海洋动态壁纸，可在 DSH 原生插件设置中调节亮度、饱和度与构图。

description.en: Windows x64 preview that detaches workspace/session navigation into a separate .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen window, with grouped trees, overview/focused modes, logical drag-and-drop, activity/manual ordering and a resizable focused-view preview; no DSH Core patch and no Better Workspace runtime dependency. Derived from KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace — do not install both.
description.zh: Windows x64 预览版：将工作区与会话导航分离到独立的 .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen 窗口，支持分组层级、总览与聚焦模式、逻辑拖放、活动或手动排序，以及可调整高度的聚焦预览区；不修改 DSH Core，不运行时依赖 Better Workspace。衍生自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace，不能与上游同装。

description.en: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a session; the file stays out of git.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

description.en: A draggable square-cake mascot that runs while a turn is in progress, sleeps when it finishes, and gets angry on errors.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的方糕萌宠：对话进行时奔跑、完成时睡觉、出错时生气。

description.en: Turns one journal paper PDF into a Chinese group-meeting literature report deck (.pptx) in the Nanyang Normal University physics template, plus a matching Word speaker script. Requires Python 3 with python-pptx, python-docx, Pillow and pymupdf (pypdf fallback); install them with pip install -r requirements.txt.
description.zh: 把一篇期刊论文做成中文组会文献汇报 PPT（南阳师范学院物理模板），并附一份配套的 Word 讲稿。需本机 Python 3 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow、pymupdf（pypdf 兜底）依赖，可用 pip install -r requirements.txt 安装。

description.en: Manage blog categories, save drafts, and upload images, audio, and video to R2 from Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 中管理博客分类、保存草稿，并将图片、音频和视频上传到 R2。

description.en: Format Markdown with publishing themes, preview the result, and export HTML or long images.
description.zh: 使用发布主题排版 Markdown，预览效果并导出 HTML 或长图。

description.en: Manage Zuad digital signage programs, media, playback schedules, and devices through DeepSeek Harness. Requires an existing Zuad signage backend and an account on it; you sign in from the plugin settings and the password stays local.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Zuad 数字标牌节目、素材、播放排程和设备。需要已有 Zuad 信发系统后台及可用账号，在插件设置里登录，密码只保存在本地。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 预测偏差与考核台账核对：依据《表示货币的代码》（电力市场考核办法与并网调度协议（无国家标准））。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查预测准确率考核台账的算术问题，核对周期、科目、预测与实际数据及准确率是否算对。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 法条引用核对：按本机构口径，无公开标准可引。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查法条引用清单是否规范可查，逐条核对法律名称、条文序号和引用格式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 信用证单据核对：依据《跟单信用证统一惯例》（UCP600）《表示货币的代码》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 帮你逐条核对信用证交单的单据类型和条款要求，快速查出不符点。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 三重一大决策记录核对：依据《关于进一步推进国有企业贯彻落实"三重一大"决策制度的意见》（中办发〔2010〕17号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查国企「三重一大」决策台账的程序留痕，看议题是否记录提案依据、前置研究等环节是否齐全。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接播放网易云音乐，支持队列、同步歌词、扫码登录，还带 AI DJ 帮你选歌。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Right-hand widget rail for the DSH Web UI: live session stats (turns, LLM/tool time, TTFT, speed, cache, tokens) and OpenCode Go quota via a same-origin host proxy; extensible widget registry for more platform usage widgets, visuals, utility actions and external integrations.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧部件栏：实时会话统计（轮次/LLM 与工具耗时/首 token 延迟/速率/缓存/tokens）与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量（同源代理）；可扩展部件注册表，为更多平台用量部件、视觉表现、实用工具与外部接口集成打基础。

description.en: Bidirectional Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向通道：持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
description.zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。
